PROJECT_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: A project groups the inboxes that belong to one product or brand, so agents can narrow Live chats to just that project instead of every inbox at once.

LIST.404: There are no projects yet. Add one to group your inboxes.

FORM.DESC: Name the project and pick the teams entitled to it and the inboxes that belong to it.

CODE.LABEL: Case prefix
CODE.HELP: Up to 10 letters or digits shown before this project's case numbers, as in CK-858. Leave it empty to show the number alone.
CODE.ERROR: Use up to 10 letters or digits

LOGO.LABEL: Logo
LOGO.HELP: Shown next to the project in the sidebar. A square image works best.

TEAMS.LABEL: Teams
TEAMS.EMPTY: There are no teams in this account yet.
TEAMS.HELP: Only members of these teams can be assigned this project's chats, admins included. Leave empty to allow every inbox member.

INBOXES.LABEL: Inboxes
INBOXES.HELP: An inbox can belong to one project. Unticking an inbox leaves it without a project.
INBOXES.EMPTY: There are no inboxes in this account yet.

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not save the project, please try again

CONFIRM.TITLE: Confirm deletion
CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not delete the project, please try again
